description.value: Big Box Outlet Store is a Canadian family-owned value retail chain operating since 1985, specializing in heavily discounted brand-name merchandise sourced through reverse logistics and open-box channels. The Murrayville location on Fraser Highway is one of 21 stores across BC and Alberta, offering inspected and re-certified items at up to 70% off retail. It is a large general merchandise outlet — useful for a touring cyclist stocking up on sundries or electronics, though it is not primarily a food retailer.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Big Box Outlet Store is a real, actively operating general merchandise/discount outlet chain with 21 locations across BC and Alberta; Murrayville is explicitly listed as a BC location. The store is a value retailer selling discounted brand-name and open-box goods, not a traditional grocery store — OSM's shop=general is accurate but the WWC 'Groceries' category mapping is loose. Neither the website nor OSM tags provide any evidence for bike parking, water, washrooms, or other cycling-specific amenities.
concerns: OSM phone (+1-604-532-8199) is a store-specific number that does not appear in the website content; website shows only a general customer service line (1-877-940-2267). Store phone could not be confirmed.
WWC category 'Groceries' is a loose fit — this is a general merchandise discount outlet, not a grocery store. May be better categorized under a general retail or convenience category if one exists.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating retail store with a confirmed web presence and Murrayville listed as a current location. Useful to touring cyclists as a general merchandise stop.
enrichment_extras.notes: The website announced a shutdown of online shopping (as of August 2025) in favour of in-store retail only; physical store locations including Murrayville remain open.

provenance.category_correction_reason: OSM tag is shop=general, which is correct. This is a general merchandise discount/outlet retailer, not a grocery store. The Groceries category mapping is imprecise but tolerable as a catch-all for general goods stores.
